label: Device Showcase
description: Apple device-glamour mockup: a CSS-3D iPhone (titanium edge, Dynamic Island), MacBook (tilted lid + keyboard deck), or an overlapping duo rises in, settles over a soft grounding shadow, and floats with a gentle 3D sway. Cast it for app/product hero beats, 'available on desktop and mobile' moments, or launch shots -- e.g. { "device": "duo", "screenshot_url": "https://example.com/dashboard.png", "screenshot_url_2": "https://example.com/mobile.png" }. Without screenshots, set "screen" to dress the iPhone with a designed fitness-app preset (real content, phone body re-tinted to match): "app-hero" (lime onboarding hero with headline + Start Now pill), "app-stats" (dark dashboard with avatar row, activity ring, progress bars), "app-chart" (white analytics screen with a big stat + area chart). Place several instances side by side with different screens for an app-trio shot. Omit both and the screen falls back to a brand-tinted UI skeleton.

screenshot_url.label: Screen image URL (lead device; placeholder skeleton when absent)

screen.label: Designed app-screen preset for the iPhone (used when no screenshot; app-hero = lime onboarding, app-stats = dark activity dashboard, app-chart = white stat + area chart)

screen_title.label: Headline for the app-hero preset (default 'Unleash Full Potential')

screen_value.label: Big number on the preset screen: ring count for app-stats (default '2'), stat for app-chart (default '740')
